entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

According to learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Petitioner is aggrieved by the non-disposal of his application filed under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 pending before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Nuapada (Opposite Party No.2).
In such background, he prays that a direction be issued to the opposite Party No.2 to dispose of the said case expeditiously.

4. Considering the submission made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
this Court disposes of the Writ Petition directing the Opposite Party No.2 to dispose of the application filed under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 in accordance with law within a period of three months from ASWINI KUMAR SETHY the date of production of a certified copy of this order and 11:32:08 +05'30' communicate the result of such exercise to the petitioner.

It is further directed that in case the application of the Petitioner under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 is allowed, and if there is no other legal impediment, the compensation amount be disbursed in favour of the Petitioner within a period of two months thereafter.
5. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
